title: bug: complete_step stores modifiedFiles unchecked and the plan sanitizer keeps only the first 50 on the next write, so paths 51+ silently leave the ASSERTED tier, while its siblings (submit_plan, the note cap) refuse past the same bound
description:
Found by hunt task-859eff80 (architect-74d9e1c7). It was held back only by the hunt's 4-row cap. The governor filed it at 16:30Z on 2026-11-03, after re-checking the citations at d5f36e82.

PROBLEM. complete_step accepts any number of modifiedFiles and stores them as given. The plan sanitizer then keeps only the first 50 on the next task write (state/validators.ts:790, `.slice(0, 50)`). The call succeeds, and no warning says paths were lost. Paths 51+ drop out of the ASSERTED attribution tier: the wrapper commits a task from its completed steps' modifiedFiles, and get_commit_scope's `asserted` no longer lists them. In shared mode those bytes stay unstaged. In every mode task.filesModified under-reports.

The sibling guards refuse instead:
- complete_step's own note cap, completeStep.ts:83-88, "refuse it up front instead, like every other capped text field";
- submit_plan, submitPlan.ts:395-402: "Step N has too many affected files (max 50)" and the same for newFiles.

EVIDENCE (HEAD ef5c7101, re-checked at d5f36e82). /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-859e/A/zzHuntAModifiedFiles.test.ts, output in zzHuntAModifiedFiles.output.txt:
- complete_step with 60 modifiedFiles returns success with no warning;
- the stored list has 50 entries;
- get_commit_scope's asserted is missing src/gen/file51.ts through file60.ts;
- the sibling control, submit_plan with 51 affectedFiles, is refused "too many affected files (max 50)".

FIX DIRECTION. Never lose a reported path silently. Two acceptable shapes; the planner picks one and says why:
(a) Refuse more than 50 modifiedFiles with INVALID_INPUT before any write, consistent with the siblings. The step stays IN_PROGRESS and no evidence is recorded. The message names the cap and the escape: report the first 50, then moe.declare_files the rest.
(b) Keep every reported path, with a bound of its own large enough for a regenerate step, e.g. record_commit's 500.
Either way, document it in docs/MCP_SERVER.md's complete_step section (around :475-490).

PLACEMENT (no dependsOn edge). task-314405bb edits MCP_SERVER.md's chat_decision section, and the docs-drift row filed alongside this one edits its set_task_status, archive_task and chat_send sections. Touch only the complete_step section.

VERIFICATION. vitest in the task worktree, never in the shared checkout: the new and changed completeStep test files, plus the existing completeStep and getCommitScope tests.
definitionOfDone: No reported path is lost silently. complete_step with more than 50 modifiedFiles is either refused with INVALID_INPUT before any write (the step stays IN_PROGRESS and the message names the cap and moe.declare_files), or stores every reported path so all of them appear in get_commit_scope's asserted. 50 or fewer behave exactly as today.
vitest covers 50 paths (all stored and asserted) and 60 paths (the chosen refusal or full retention), and the existing completeStep and getCommitScope tests still pass.
docs/MCP_SERVER.md's complete_step section states the bound and what happens past it.
